== Research Notes ==
A possible identification concerns William Hay. The source previously cited for a supposed 8 November 1839 Kilraughts marriage was rechecked. Its entry is for Alexander Montgomery, a shoemaker, marrying Jane McCaughey, daughter of John McCaughey, before witnesses Betty Hay and William Hay.<ref>Ulster Lees, Ballymoney area research, entry for Alexander Montgomery and Jane McCaughey; [https://ulsterlees.azurewebsites.net/families/co-antrim/ballymoney-area/ record]; Churchtown Presbyterian baptisms; [https://genealogy.torrens.org/BannValley/church/TamlaghtP/Baptisms.html record].</ref> It does not name Alexander Glasgow, Mary McCaughan/McAughin, or any Glasgow parent. The identification remains uncertain.
